name: IMDb Top 250
description: IMDb's Top 250 by weighted user rating. Volatile list, so it is configurable rather than hardcoded.
_howto: IMDb's Top 250 changes constantly. To populate it, EITHER (a) set 'tmdbListId' to a public TMDB list that mirrors it (find one at https://www.themoviedb.org/search and copy the numeric id from the list URL), OR (b) drop a CSV named imdb_top250.csv in this folder with columns Title,Year (an optional tmdbId column skips matching). Then re-run build_lists.py.
